sketch:
Observe: same schematic canvas as intensite-courant, but student drops
a voltmeter across any two nodes (parallel-legal placements
highlighted). HUD shows U in V; a coloured "potential-height" bar
overlay along the loop reifies the analogy to hydraulic head.
Experiment: student places voltmeters across each dipole to verify
loop law (ΣU = 0). Evaluate: given target voltages for three dipoles,
student picks resistor values that satisfy them all. Wrinkle: U is a
difference between two points, not a property of a wire — enforced by
the two-terminal probe UI.
